conflicts.fact: Number and identity of the six chemicals of life
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, vitamins, mineral salts, water (minerals separate, no nucleic acids). Lessons 2 and 6: carbohydrates, proteins, lipids, nucleic acids, vitamins/minerals (combined), water. Lesson 5 template also has six boxes and expects nucleic acids, vitamins and minerals as separate gaps.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson the food tests (iodine, Biuret) were performed in, and what lipid tests were
conflicts.versions: Lesson 3 performed only lipid tests (translucent spot, ethanol emulsion) and said it is Observe Part 2 with no starch/protein tests. Lesson 4 contains no food tests (reading, bottle-top models, mapping). Lesson 5 says iodine and Biuret results were observed 'in Lesson 4', and Lesson 6 also cites food test results from Lesson 4. Lesson 3's CER modelling example cites a biuret test as if already done.

conflicts.fact: Which lesson contains the comparison tables used for the model
conflicts.versions: Lesson 6 refers to comparison tables from Lesson 3, but Lesson 3 produced lipid test result tables only; the Lesson 2 composition cards were the comparison data.

conflicts.fact: Composition/lipid content of ugali and the Kisumu menu
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 card gives ugali ~1% fat; Lesson 3 says ugali tested negative for lipids and is 'absent in lipids'. Lesson 6 menu evaluation uses ugali with sukuma wiki and fried fish, with no lipid data consistent.

Lesson 3 says the Cumulative Chemical Model poster was started in Lesson 1 and updated in Lesson 2, whereas Lesson 1 builds only a before-and-after notebook diagram individually and Lesson 4 says a personal notebook model (not group A3 poster); Lesson 5 starts a new blank A3 template as 'the beginning' of the final model.
Lesson 4 overview lists milk and sukuma wiki; observed lists sugarcane juice and chai instead of milk and sukuma wiki.

Lesson 2 describes the sick child's ugali as 'maize starch only'; Lesson 6 menu and other lessons present ugali with sukuma wiki as a typical diet; Lesson 1 also has students sort sukuma wiki as a separate food.

Lesson 5 says marasmus is total caloric energy deficiency, matched to a 'missing chemical of life', while the matching card requires a missing chemical for each disease; inconsistent with the 'missing chemical' framing
